info.name: BodyTrace RPM Data Alerts Provisioning API

params.name: imei
params.description: The device IMEI (serial). BodyTrace documents this as the IMEI without leading zeros and without the final check digit.

items.docs: Associate a device (by IMEI) with an account, patient, or program and configure where its measurements are delivered - including an optional pushed HTTP endpoint (webhook) that BodyTrace should POST readings to. MODELED from BodyTrace's documented onboarding flow; provisioning is completed with BodyTrace and gated behind credentials.
